OldWestTown.Stagecoach.CoachTierDef.label: irregular freight wagons
OldWestTown.Stagecoach.CoachTierDef.description: A wagon comes through when it comes through — no fixed day, just a promise that one eventually will. The loosest guarantee the line offers: a big-spending group won't be more than about eight days behind whatever the ordinary arrival clock is already doing.

OldWestTown.Stagecoach.CoachTierDef.label: weekly coach
OldWestTown.Stagecoach.CoachTierDef.description: A real schedule now, even if it's chalked on a board that changes every so often. The gap between guaranteed arrivals tightens, the coach's own passengers carry noticeably more silver, and every so often one of them is worth a second look.

OldWestTown.Stagecoach.CoachTierDef.label: daily express
OldWestTown.Stagecoach.CoachTierDef.description: The top of the line: a coach through here most days, running well-heeled custom on the tightest guarantee the route offers and the best odds anywhere of a passenger worth naming in the letter.
